summary: Tier 7 Pre-launch Sweep (Signatures & Drawings) backend testing complete. 22/24 tests pass (91.7%). All 7.1 signature endpoints work end-to-end (capture, list, file retrieval, requirement, request via email, public token negative paths). 7.2 Order Drawings: create/list/query/file-retrieval/blank-rejection all pass, but TWO real backend bugs were discovered in update + delete flows.

critical.issue: Returns 403 'Only admins can delete drawings' for the production owner account (role='platform_admin'). The route only allows roles ('owner','admin','superadmin') — 'platform_admin' (the highest role, which the founder uses) is missing from the allow-list. Result: the user's primary admin account at thesigntistslab@gmail.com cannot delete any drawing.

Updating ONLY 'label' (without also sending 'title') silently does not change the visible label. Root cause: PUT writes label to DB but leaves title untouched; _serialize_drawing then overrides response label with `payload.get('title') or payload.get('label')`. So the GET/list and the PUT response both return the OLD title-as-label. Frontend DrawingModal that sends only label will appear to never persist edits.

action_items: Fix DELETE /api/order-drawings/{drawing_id} role check in /app/backend/routes/order_drawings.py line 213: add 'platform_admin' to the allowed roles tuple — `if current_user.role not in ('owner','admin','superadmin','platform_admin')`. Same role-check pattern likely exists elsewhere; audit all RBAC tuples for missing platform_admin.

Fix PUT /api/order-drawings/{drawing_id} in /app/backend/routes/order_drawings.py: when 'label' is provided, mirror it into 'title' so _serialize_drawing returns the new value. Add: `if updates.get('label') and 'title' not in updates: updates['title'] = updates['label']` (mirror of the existing title→label logic on line 201-202).
critical_code_review_comments: order_drawings.py _serialize_drawing forces label = title or label which makes label storage ambiguous; consider storing a single canonical field instead of duplicating title/label.
POST /api/signatures/request stores request_token in DB but never returns it to the caller; this is correct from a security standpoint (token only emails to customer) — keeping this as-is.
signatures.py: list endpoint correctly excludes request_token from responses (validated by test).
Signature capture rejects images <1000 bytes server-side; drawings reject <150 bytes — both validations work as documented.
Public signature flow's 410 expiration logic was not exercised because tests cannot retrieve the request_token from the API; only negative-path 404 cases verified.

seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_Tier7_* signatures and one drawing during the test run. Drawing was deleted at end of suite (or rather, attempted — left soft-state as 403 blocked deletion). Remaining TEST_Tier7_* signatures persist on order ORD-0001.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run /app/backend/tests/test_tier7_signatures_drawings.py after main agent fixes the two bugs. Drawing test_update_drawing currently asserts label persistence; if main agent makes label↔title symmetric, it will pass. Drawing test_delete_drawing requires 'platform_admin' added to the delete allow-list. Public signature sign/decline happy-path is currently untestable from outside because the API does not expose request_token after creation; if a future endpoint returns it (or admin can fetch it), extend that section. Signature capture properly stamps signer_name and signed_at, but IP address capture (a Tier 7 requirement) is NOT implemented in /app/backend/routes/signatures.py — the capture model has no client_ip field and the route does not extract request.client.host. Flag for main agent if 7.1 'Signature with signer name + IP address storage' is required.

rca_of_the_issue.delete_drawing_403: current_user.role='platform_admin' for the founder account, but order_drawings.py line 213 hard-codes allowed=('owner','admin','superadmin'). platform_admin is the SaaS-platform-level admin role and should always have at least owner-level permissions on tenant data. Mitigation: extend the tuple, or replace with a centralised RBAC helper.
rca_of_the_issue.update_drawing_label_not_persisted: DrawingUpdate accepts label and title separately. The PUT handler writes whatever fields are provided. _serialize_drawing then computes response.label = title or label. If caller sends only label, title remains old and the response masks the new label. Mitigation: when label is updated and title is not, copy label into title (symmetric to the existing title->label sync at line 201-202).
